notes: Switch lowered to a mtctr/bdzf chain with no range check and case 0 as fall-through; every source form tried (switch with default holding if(n!=0), explicit case 0, if-chain) gave either a range check or a base-1 (addi -1) chain, so all addresses shift and the percentage stays low although the body logic is fully decoded.

Smart-pointer base-to-derived adjust (p ? p-28 : 0): target uses a branch with the addi hoisted (cmplwi; addi; bne; li) and jump-threaded null checks, while ternary/if/early-return/static_cast all gave select idiom (subfic/subfe/and), addic. or branch-over; also needed __vector4 + hidden-return for ReadGlobalPosition and reconstructing about 450 bytes of nested inlined accessors.

Vector matrix scale: fixed the hidden-return struct copy by modelling the matrix getter as returning a Mat* (ctor-like), but could not force the three XMVectorReplicate stack slots to stay live simultaneously (compiler reuses/merges slots) so frame size, register use and scheduling differ; early prologue scheduling also differs.

Script-binding table: needed 8-byte member-function pointers (multiple-inheritance class) sharing one stack slot with the 4-byte handle (alias trick) and inline heap-allocation of the binding object; remaining 30 differing words are only scheduling of the adj store (stw r31,+4) relative to lis/li which source reordering did not change.
